title: CO-Net: Learning Multiple Point Cloud Tasks at Once with A Cohesive Network
caption: Figure 1. The network architecture of CO-Net. CO-Net jointly optimizes multiple point cloud tasks and consists of three components, that is, stem MLP, backbone, and heads for various tasks. The nested layer-wise processing policy is applied to each layer of the backbone to identify optimal architectures for different tasks and automatically decide which parameters of the backbone to be shared, through which we can generate task-related features. The parts in solid lines mean they are chosen while those in dashed lines are not.
